# Property-visibility matrix

Legend: **M** manifest; **C** available only through a certificate; **H**
hidden/not yet interpreted; **O** open for the desired 4D continuum chain.

| Representation | Locality | Gauge invariance | Positivity | Scale flow | Observable completeness | Spectral rigidity |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| lattice link variables | M | covariance M; physical quotient C | action-dependent C | H | C | finite spectrum only |
| gauge-orbit observables | C | M | C | H | O across topology | H |
| blocked/RG action | range-dependent C | C | may be lost/recovered | M | O | contraction proxy C |
| continuum Schwinger data | distributional C | physical algebra C | OS positivity O | covariance M | O | Euclidean decay C |
| OS Hilbert representation | local net C | Gauss/physical sector C | M | physical time M | dense core O | M once reconstructed |
| auxiliary sampling dynamics | algorithmic locality M | implementation-dependent | Markov positivity M | algorithmic | irrelevant | not a physical certificate |

No row dominates every other.  The representation calculus is designed to
track the missing implications between columns rather than to select one
globally privileged formalism.
